findings.title: +3V3 sags to 2.04 V under load
findings.detail: U4 (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8) needs 3 V. Worst corner: minimum input, everything switching (source at 3.00 V): +3V3 dips to 2.04 V and settles at 2.04 V, with +BATT pulled down to 2.42 V across 0.45 ohm of source path. At nominal input on its own the rail holds 3.06 V.

findings.title: 0.4 mm supply tracks carry up to 1269 mA (+BATT, BAT_P1, BAT_P1F, BAT_RAW)
findings.detail: IPC-2221 gives 1.23 A for a 10 C rise at this width in 35 um copper. +BATT: 1269 mA, 160 mm at this width; BAT_P1: 1269 mA, 7 mm at this width; BAT_P1F: 1269 mA, 6 mm at this width; BAT_RAW: 1269 mA, 16 mm at this width. Not every segment carries a net's whole current: check the ones between the source and the loads, and widen or pour them. The resistance also costs voltage: see the droop result.

findings.title: U3 drops out of regulation when +BATT is below 3.61 V at peak load
findings.detail: +BATT spans 3 to 4.2 V. Below 3.61 V with 356 mA drawn the output follows the input down, about 314 mV beneath it. U4 (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8) needs 3 V: at peak load that is lost once +BATT is under 3.31 V, well before 3 V. Expect brown-out resets on current peaks with a part-discharged source.

findings.title: Strapping pin U4.4(IO0) is used (BOOT)
findings.detail: U4 (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8) samples this pin at reset (default: high; boot_high: SPI boot: normal boot from flash (IO46 any value); boot_low: joint download boot (UART0 / USB), needs IO46 low). Connected here: SW3.1. Whatever is attached must not hold the wrong level while the module comes out of reset.
findings.basis: part model parts/esp32-s3-mini-1.yaml (verified against datasheet)

findings.title: U4.7(IO3) must not float
findings.detail: U4 (ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8): only TP8.1 on the net. GPIO3 has no internal pull; its strapping value must be controlled by an external circuit that cannot be high impedance (section 4.4). Applies when: only if EFUSE_STRAP_JTAG_SEL has been burnt to 1; with the default eFuses GPIO3 is ignored (Table 4-5).
findings.basis: part model parts/esp32-s3-mini-1.yaml (verified against datasheet)

findings.title: U4.21(IO17) can see 3.667 V; its limit is 3.53 V
findings.detail: Net CHG_STAT (divider R10/R19 from CHG_STAT_5V (U2.1(STAT) high = VBUS)). Limit: supply (+3V3 at its minimum 3.234 V) + 0.3 V. The excess is within a few hundred millivolts: it arises when the two supplies are at opposite ends of their ranges. The source impedance (100k) limits the current into the pin's protection diode to about 20 uA: outside the datasheet limit, harmless in practice. Also note the pin is driven while the part is unpowered if this source comes up first.
findings.basis: part model parts/esp32-s3-mini-1.yaml (verified against datasheet)
